enlargement.analysis: Native zoom shortcuts did not enlarge the page. Independent read-only assessment found supported Windows Display Scale through retained per-monitor-DPI awareness and WebView2 rasterization; therefore disabled browser zoom alone does not demonstrate a defect. Text-size-only support was not established.
